items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/ Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $164,200 — $229,990 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States AI Data Quality Analyst Job Title: AI Data Quality Analyst Location: United States (Remote) Work Mode: 100% Remote Experience: 2–6 Years Salary Range: $70,000 – $115,000 per year (USD) Employment Type: Full-Time Job Category: Artificial Intelligence / Data Analytics / Data Quality Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical AI Data Quality Analyst to join our growing AI and Data Engineering team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating, validating, cleaning, and maintaining datasets used in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. The candidate should have experience in data quality assessment, data validation, data annotation, SQL, Python, and AI/ML data workflows. This role involves ensuring data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability to improve AI model performance. This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States. Key Responsibilities Analyze, validate, and maintain datasets used for AI and machine learning applications. Identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, and inaccurate data. Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and quality checks. Evaluate training and testing datasets for accuracy and completeness. Develop and maintain data quality standards and validation procedures. Review AI-generated outputs and identify data-related errors or inconsistencies. Perform data annotation, labeling, classification, and categorization when required. Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and Data Engineers. Create SQL queries and Python scripts for automated data validation. Monitor data quality metrics and prepare analytical reports. Identify root causes of data quality issues and recommend corrective actions. Maintain data documentation, validation logs, and quality reports. Support continuous improvement of AI training datasets and data pipelines. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–6 years of experience in Data Quality Analysis, Data Analytics, or AI Data Quality roles. Strong understanding of data validation, data cleaning, and data profiling. Working knowledge of SQL and database management. Experience with Python for data analysis and validation. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and data processing libraries. Understanding of AI, machine learning, and data preparation workflows. Experience with structured and unstructured datasets. Knowledge of data annotation and labeling methodologies. Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, and data visualization tools. Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience with AI/ML training data evaluation. Familiarity with data quality tools and frameworks. Knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools. Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehousing. Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance standards. Experience evaluating LLM outputs and Generative AI datasets. Salary & Benefits Annual Salary: $70,000 – $115,000 USD. Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise. 100% remote work opportunity. Flexible working arrangements. Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Retirement savings benefits, where applicable. Professional development and training opportunities. Career advancement opportunities. Work Location United States – Fully Remote Candidates from eligible locations across the United States are encouraged to apply. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Ability to collaborate with distributed teams across different US time zones. How to Apply Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with contact details, relevant AI Data Quality experience, technical skills, and project portfolios. Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse professional backgrounds and encourage applications from eligible candidates across the United States. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/edgeq-technologies-private-limited-ai-data-quality-analyst

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Poland At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion. Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy. Location - Remote Poland The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analytics-engineer-ii-full-stack-revenue-analytics

items.summary: Addepto is a leading AI consulting ( https://addepto.com/ai-consulting/ ) and data engineering ( https://addepto.com/data-engineering-services/ ) company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide . As part of KMS Technology , a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilitiesâenabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong skills in GCP, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and Data Analytics to join our team. You will work on international data engineering and analytics projects, focusing on building scalable data solutions, modernizing data warehouses, and supporting data-driven business decisions. Project areas include: Data Warehouse & BI Modernization â refactoring data models and supporting migrations between BI platforms (e.g., Looker to Omni). CRM Data Integration â developing and optimizing data models to support CRM migrations and integrations (e.g., HubSpot). Commercial & Growth Analytics â building analytical solutions for customer acquisition, retention, churn, revenue, and business performance. Data Quality & Self-Service Analytics â improving data reliability, implementing semantic layers, and enabling accessible analytics and AI-ready datasets. ð Your main responsibilities: Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and data models using modern cloud technologies. Build and maintain dbt models and complex data transformations using Python and SQL . Support data warehouse modernization , BI migrations, and integration of multiple data sources. Develop analytical datasets and reporting solutions to support business decisions. Ensure data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation . Collaborate with engineering teams, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data solutions. ð¯ What you'll need to succeed in this role: 3+ years of commercial experience in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering . Strong hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery) and Snowflake . Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL , including complex data transformations, data processing, and query optimization. Strong practical experience with dbt , including developing, testing, and optimizing data models. Solid understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT processes , and data architecture best practices. Hands-on experience with BI and reporting tools , such as Looker, LookML, Omni, Power BI, or Tableau . Experience with workflow orchestration tools , such as Apache Airflow or equivalent solutions. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews , and automated testing. Good understanding of data quality, monitoring, and data governance practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with business stakeholders. Excellent English communication skills (C1 minimum) . â Nice to have: Knowledge of CRM systems , such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Experience with semantic layers , BI migrations, or data warehouse refactoring. Background in fintech, SaaS, or commercial analytics . Familiarity with A/B testing, product analytics , or AI-ready data solutions. ðÂ Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces.Â Accelerate your professional growth throughÂ career paths ,Â knowledge-sharing Â initiatives,Â language Â classes, and sponsored Â training Â orÂ conferences , including partnerships withÂ Databricks and Anthropic , which offer industry-leading training materials and certifications. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support. You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing. You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns. You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources. You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access. You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery. You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations. You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents. You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting. You’ll automate repeatable operational activities such as provisioning, access configuration, monitoring deployment, recovery, and platform changes. You’ll manage secure access controls, secrets, certificates, TLS configuration, service accounts, and IAM roles across platform services. You’ll improve operational readiness through runbooks, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, standards, escalation paths, and technical documentation. You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate. You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity. What You Bring Skills & experience Required Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls. Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking. Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools. Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments. Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices. Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages. Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Nice to Have Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles. Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms. Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling. Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures. Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). items.title: Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance at Twilio
items.summary: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusio
items.description: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4). About the job We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services. We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you. You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn’t followed a traditional path, don’t let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting. Sharp written and verbal communication skills. Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors. Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis. Experience in project management. Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL. Desired: Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains. Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum. Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files. Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards. Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries. Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity. Location This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or the surrounding areas of San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, or San Jose, CA Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Compensation *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above. The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. 108,720.00 - $135,900.00. Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $115,120.00 - $143,900.00. Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $127,920.00 - $159,900.00. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs) Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 30, 2026, but may change based on business needs. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That’s why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you’re ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote- USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience. The Difference You Will Make: As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. A Typical Day: Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution Your Expertise: 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch) 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS) Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto) Experience with Infrastructure as Code Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus Your Location This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $136,000 — $160,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) **This is a contract role expected to last until April 15th, 2027 Location : This role is Remote in the U.S., with the option to work onsite from our San Francisco, CA headquarters. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. About Doximity Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will: Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates. Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours. What We're Looking For We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications: Must have: Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients. Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships. Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA. Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Working knowledge of statistics and visualization. Experience working with data visualization tools. Advanced Excel skills. Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows. Experience working in the healthcare industry. Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience. The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-business-intelligence-analyst-contractor

items.summary: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records. Â About the Client Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact. Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale. Â About the Project & Role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions. The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data. The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework. This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features. Responsibilities Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights. Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework , including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management. Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations. Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture. Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications. Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution . Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs. Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience Core Requirements 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering . Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations. Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation. Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs. Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring. Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Strongly Preferred Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain , particularly migration between frameworks. Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash. Nice-to-Have Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains. Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production. Familiarity with React and FastAPI. Interview Process Interview with GT Recruiter Cultural Fit Interview Technical Interview Final Interview Offer Why Join Our Client? Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems. Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform . Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential. Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex . Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. Please mention the word **UNCOMPLICATED** and tag RNTIuMTczLjIxOS4xNDg= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjIxOS4xNDg=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

Â About the Project & Role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions. Responsibilities Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights. Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework , including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management. Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations. Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture. Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications. Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution . Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs. Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience Core Requirements 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering . Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash. Nice-to-Have Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains. Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production. Familiarity with React and FastAPI. items.description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote

items.summary: Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team.
items.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world. Responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. #DataScientist #RemoteWork #MachineLearning #DataAnalysis #DataScience #RemoteJob #AI #PredictiveModeling #DataMining #Statistics #RemoteTech #WorkFromAnywhere #TechJobs #DataAnalytics #ArtificialIntelligence #Python #RemoteOpportunity Originally posted on Himalayas
