items.summary: Headquarters: US, Remote URL: http://horizon3.ai Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomou
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: US, Remote URL: http://horizon3.ai Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. What You'll Do Investigate complex failures across the entire stack. A single case might take you from Kubernetes pod scheduling, through container networking, into cloud IAM permissions, and into our application logs in Datadog. You own the investigation end to end. Be the technical bridge between customers and engineering. You'll translate customer-reported symptoms into actionable bug reports with reproduction steps, logs, and root cause hypotheses. When engineering ships a fix, you verify it actually solves the problem in the customer's environment. Build tooling and automation. If you're doing something manually more than twice, you build a tool. We need someone who writes Python scripts, builds internal dashboards, automates data collection from Zendesk and Jira, and creates runbooks that make the whole team more effective. Drive systemic improvements. You'll spot patterns across tickets that point to product gaps, documentation holes, or infrastructure reliability issues. You bring the data, make the case, and work with engineering and product to fix the root cause, not just the symptom. Go deep on web application security. Our platform now does web app pentesting. You need to understand common vulnerability classes (OWASP top 10), how web scanners work, and how to explain findings and their implications to customers who range from security experts to IT generalists. Mentor the team and raise the technical bar. You'll help junior and senior engineers develop their troubleshooting skills, create training content, and establish patterns for how the team approaches complex investigations. What We're Looking For Must have: 8+ years of hands-on technical experience. The title on your resume matters less than what you've actually done. We'll take an SRE who built incident response tooling, a backend developer who ran production infrastructure, or a support engineer who can write real code and read Terraform. Strong Linux fundamentals. You're comfortable on a command line, can troubleshoot a hung process on RHEL, understand SELinux, and don't need a GUI to be productive. Container and Kubernetes experience. You've deployed and troubleshot containerized workloads. You know the difference between a CrashLoopBackOff and an ImagePullBackOff and what to do about each. Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You understand IAM, networking (VPCs, security groups, firewalls), and have worked with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) -- not just reading plans, but writing and debugging them when provisioning fails. GraphQL and web application fluency. Our API is GraphQL. You can trace a request from a React frontend through the GraphQL layer to the backend, interpret query/mutation responses (including partial errors in a 200), and debug auth flows, CORS issues, and network failures using browser dev tools. Database fundamentals. You can write SQL to investigate data issues, understand relational and NoSQL concepts, and ideally have exposure to graph databases -- our product maps attack paths and relationships that are naturally graph-shaped. Scripting ability in Python and Bash. You've built automation that other people actually use, not just one-off scripts for yourself. Observability tool experience (Datadog preferred). You can search logs, build queries, read traces, and correlate signals across services to find where something broke. Strong communication skills. You'll write to customers, file bugs for engineering, and present findings to product. Each audience needs a different approach and you adjust naturally. Big pluses: Background in cybersecurity, pentesting, or AppSec. Understanding of common exploit classes, vulnerability assessment, and security tooling. Experience with web application security. Familiar with XSS, SQLi, SSRF, auth bypass, IDOR, and how WAFs and CDNs affect security testing. Active Directory experience. Many of our customers' environments are AD-heavy, and NodeZero tests AD attack paths (password audits, credential attacks, privilege escalation). Understanding AD architecture, GPOs, trusts, and common misconfigurations is a real advantage. Full-stack development experience. You've shipped production code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go. Deep graph database experience (Neo4j or similar). Our attack path data is graph-native -- if you can write Cypher queries and understand graph traversal, you'll hit the ground running. Certifications (AWS SA Pro, CKA, RHCE, OSCP, or similar). Not required, but signals self-direction and depth. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR). Useful given our customer base. Travel Required We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful. Perks of Horizon3 Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. Compensation and Values At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams About You You likely have: Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS Why This Role Matters Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company. As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $145,000-$165,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-sr-data-engineer

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, data infrastructure, and data processing systems that support machine learning and artificial intelligence applications. The candidate should have strong expertise in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, big data technologies, and machine learning data workflows. This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for machine learning and AI applications. Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for structured and unstructured datasets. Develop data ingestion, transformation, validation, and processing solutions. Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and AI teams to prepare high-quality training datasets. Implement data preprocessing, feature engineering, and feature extraction pipelines. Manage large-scale datasets using distributed processing technologies. Develop and maintain cloud-based data infrastructure. Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and automated validation processes. Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing performance. Support machine learning model training, evaluation, and deployment workflows. Integrate data from APIs, databases, streaming platforms, and external sources. Implement data governance, security, and compliance best practices. Maintain technical documentation and participate in code reviews. Required Skills & Qualifications 3–8 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Machine Learning Data Engineering, or related roles. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines. Experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, or similar distributed processing frameworks. Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. Experience with Apache Airflow, Dagster, or similar workflow orchestration tools. Understanding of machine learning data preparation and feature engineering. Knowledge of data modeling, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures. Experience with Git, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Feast, or other MLOps and feature store technologies. Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn. Experience with Apache Kafka or real-time streaming pipelines. Knowledge of Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi. Experience supporting Generative AI and LLM data pipelines. Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation. Experience with data governance, lineage, and privacy frameworks. Salary & Benefits Annual Salary: $110,000 – $175,000 USD (Indicative range based on experience and technical expertise). Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives, where applicable. 100% remote work opportunity. Flexible working arrangements. Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Retirement savings benefits, where applicable. Professional development and technical certification support. Career growth and advancement opportunities. Work Location United States – Fully Remote Candidates from eligible locations across the United States are encouraged to apply. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Ability to collaborate with distributed teams across different US time zones. Occasional virtual meetings and collaboration with engineering stakeholders may be required. How to Apply Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with contact details, relevant Machine Learning Data Engineering experience, technical skills, and links to GitHub repositories or project portfolios. Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse professional backgrounds and encourage applications from eligible candidates across the United States. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/edgeq-technologies-private-limited-machine-learning-data-engineer

items.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
items.summary:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year 
 Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Solutions Engineer
items.summary: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503) Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL) Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System Presales experience, including building and delivering demos Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief. items.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
items.summary: Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.mozilla.org Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each mont
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.mozilla.org Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products. We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close. Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts. The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better. What you'll do: Own New Products financials : Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed. Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights . Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound. Drive team standardization and reporting : Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view. Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion. Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles. What you'll bring: Core Experience 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis. B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Technical Skills Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy. Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred). Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle. Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms. Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment. Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work. Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy. Communication & Collaboration Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience. Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context. Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on. Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly. Nice to have: Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn. Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages. Success Factors You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you… Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines. Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints. Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress. Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers. See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer. What you'll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly wellbeing stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. Group: D #LI-REMOTE Req ID: R3283 Hiring Ranges: Canada Tier 1 Locations $70,000 — $93,000 CAD Canada Tier 2 Locations $63,000 — $84,000 CAD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mozilla-senior-financial-analyst-commercial-finance

items.title: Data Analyst, Clinical Data Effectiveness
items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proac
items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 5+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clover-health-data-analyst-clinical-data-effectiveness

items.title: PhD Scientist — STEM Expert
items.summary: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point.
items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas

The chance to gain experience in various fields and participate in exciting projects. Your ideas and initiatives are always welcome and valued. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote-US ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast. ZoomInfo is seeking a Principal Product Manager, Identity to own the intelligence layer that connects digital signals to real-world business outcomes. In this high-impact role, you'll be responsible for the identity resolution engine that de-anonymizes web traffic, links visitors to companies and contacts, and powers products like WebSights and FormComplete. As a Principal PM, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, data science, and customer value creation. You'll drive systematic improvements to visitor-to-person and IP-to-company match rates, integrate new data sources, and ensure identity data flows seamlessly across ZoomInfo's GTM Intelligence Platform. Your work directly impacts how thousands of customers identify, engage, and convert their ideal buyers. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: https://bpcs.com About Blueprint Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. In This Role We are seeking a detail-oriented Supply Chain Planner to support short-term planning for server hardware deployment. In this role, you will help translate customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans, track hardware availability, and ensure the right equipment is available at the right location and time. You will work extensively with Excel, planning systems, and operational data to reconcile information, identify supply and demand gaps, monitor inventory, and track deployment requirements. This is a hands-on position that requires strong supply chain knowledge, analytical skills, and a willingness to manage detailed manual processes to keep planning activities accurate and on schedule. You will collaborate with regional capacity managers and cross-functional partners, independently manage day-to-day planning responsibilities, and follow open actions through resolution. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, solving operational challenges, and turning supply chain requirements into executable plans. Responsibilities Support short-term supply chain planning for server hardware deployment, translating customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans. Partner with regional capacity managers and cross-functional teams to understand hardware requirements, priorities, quantities, and delivery timelines. Analyze demand and supply data to identify capacity gaps, inventory constraints, delivery risks, and potential mitigation actions. Create, update, and maintain demand entries in planning systems, ensuring accuracy across quantities, locations, and required delivery dates. Leverage Microsoft Excel to reconcile datasets, validate planning information, track changes, analyze capacity, and prepare operational reports. Monitor hardware inventory, supply availability, costs, lead times, and deployment schedules to support planning decisions. Perform detailed manual tracking and maintain accurate records of planning inputs, open actions, risks, and delivery progress. Follow up with partner teams to resolve discrepancies, address planning gaps, and ensure requirements progress from initial planning through execution. Independently manage daily planning activities while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines. Qualifications 5–7 years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, capacity planning, inventory planning, or related operations. Strong understanding of supply chain fundamentals, logistics, inventory management, and demand and supply planning processes. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets. Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, updating, and validating demand or supply plans within planning systems. Experience analyzing supply and demand gaps, tracking inventory, monitoring lead times, and managing deployment schedules. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, assess risks, and maintain accurate planning data. Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work rather than focusing primarily on project coordination or oversight. Strong communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple teams. Ability to work a consistent Pacific Time (PST) schedule. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field. Experience supporting hardware supply chain operations, server deployment, data center infrastructure, or technology logistics. Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and hardware inventory management. Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and data visualization tools. Experience working with enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management, or demand planning systems. Experience coordinating supply planning activities across geographically distributed teams. Salary Range At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $33– $36 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maint
items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: US URL: https://knack.com Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote) If US-Based: This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval. International Contractor: This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone. Role Overview Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities. We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. About Knack Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code. Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations. To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact. Key Responsibilities Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions. Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it. Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent. Make AWS and Claude work together Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes. Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do. Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability. Implement security controls with our security lead Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets. Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment. Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk. Support compliance and audits Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups. Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change. Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling. Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts. Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them. Keep systems patched and current Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals. Operate and scale databases and customer environments Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms. Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support. Resolve escalations and automate repeat work Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering. Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces. Participate in on-call Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat. Qualifications Experience 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number. Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally. Technical depth Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS. Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is. Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts. Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production. Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals. Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch. How you work with AI Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation. Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments. A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling. Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers. Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows. Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild. Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling). Kubernetes/EKS experience. Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats. Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting
