items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, US About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for. About the Role The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team. Responsibilities Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure. Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most. Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates. Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both. Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel. Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early. Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer. Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team. Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data. Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team. We're Looking For Someone Who Has 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience. A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams. The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders. Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI. Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals. Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots. A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward. Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first. Bonus Points For Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development. Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity. Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling. #LI-Remote Benefits and Perks Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care Mental Wellness Benefit Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays Enhanced Parental Leave Volunteer Time Off Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* Culture Values Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress. Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations. Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star. Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible. Why choose Mixpanel? We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions. Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii-1

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - USA PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes. PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting. What's the job to be done? Visual Brand Development Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts. Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise. In-Person Experiences Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events. Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use. Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials. Website and Digital Assets Design creative website components and landing pages. Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible. Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets. Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly. Brand Evolution Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity. Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence. Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines. These attributes best describe you. A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design. Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy. You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it. Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details. Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction. Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision. What else will help you be successful. Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools. Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup. Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking. Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools. Why PlanetScale We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America. At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status. If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate! Total Compensation and Pay Transparency An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process. Base salary range: $170,000 - $220,000 USD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-brand-designer

items.description: About Nintex: At Nintex, we are transforming the way people work, everywhere. As the global standard for process intelligence and automation, we’re trusted by over 10,000 public and private sector organizations across 90 countries. Our customers, from industry giants like Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Microsoft, rely on the Nintex Platform to accelerate their digital transformation journeys by managing, automating, and optimizing business processes quickly and efficiently. We improve their lives through the technology we build. We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports amazing people in doing their very best work every day. Collaboration is constant, our workplace is fun, the environment is fast-paced, and we value our people’s curiosity, ideas, and enthusiasm. Driven by passion and accountability, we take initiative, measure progress, and deliver results. Our culture fosters innovation and problem-solving, fueled by curiosity and a commitment to thinking big. Together, we move with agility, prioritize customer needs, and build unity through empathy, leaving a positive impact wherever we go. Working in engineering: Working at Nintex as an engineer means building more than just software; it’s about making a tangible impact with every line of code. Our engineers are process experts, developing the industry’s most complete process and automation platform to transform the way people work. If you’re interested, curious and want to learn and do more, the sky is the limit here. We take a solutions-oriented and collaborative approach, constantly innovating our business and products. About the role: As a Senior Software Engineer on Nintex’s Site Reliability Engineering team, your customers are Nintex’s own engineers. You’ll build the tooling, automation, and platform capabilities that our engineering teams depend on to ship fast and run reliably. Our SRE team is a mixture of software engineers and engineers from a DevOps background, and software projects are a regular part of what we do. We follow Google’s definition of SRE: treat operations as a software problem. The work spans developer experience, platform reliability, automation, performance testing and internal tooling. One quarter you might build AI agents with SRE skills, or an API for our delivery teams’ pipelines. The next, it could be a custom plugin for a tool like Grafana, or automation that takes toil off engineers’ plates. We work spec-first, with AI in the loop. Using Nintex’s own proven spec-driven development process, you get the thinking right in a spec, then use AI tools such as Claude to go from spec to working software quickly. Your time goes into system design, sharp specs, critical review of what AI produces, and owning the result in production. We build in languages such as Go , Python and TypeScript , on Azure and AWS . Deployments run through ArgoCD, code and pipelines live in GitHub, and we use Claude Code for AI-assisted coding. Nintex is a large company with an excellent culture, and this team feels more like a start-up. There is real room to put ideas forward and run with them. You’ll often take an idea, build a proof of concept on your own, and present it back to the SRE team, the Platform team, or all of Nintex R&D. As a Senior Engineer you work independently, with the trust and freedom to decide the best way forward. Your peers rely on you as a technical resource, and you help other engineers grow through pairing, review and honest feedback. Your contribution will be: Design, build and own internal tools, automation and platform capabilities that improve engineer productivity and platform reliability, from spec to production Partner with Platform Engineers on developer experience projects that remove friction from how Nintex teams build, test, ship and run software Apply Nintex’s proven spec-driven development process, and use AI tools such as Claude Code to speed up design, implementation, testing and review Own the quality of everything you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it: review critically, test meaningfully and build in observability from day one Put ideas forward and prove them out with solo proof-of-concept projects, then present what you learned back to the teams Build performance testing and reliability tooling that finds problems before they reach production Work with engineering teams across Nintex to find where they lose time, and measure whether what you built fixed it Debug and resolve complex technical issues in production and development environments, then automate away the cause Help set direction through quarterly planning and prioritisation, technical design discussions and reviews Mentor other engineers through pairing, design and code review, and knowledge sharing Document specs, decisions and systems so that both people and AI tools can work with them Identify technical debt and toil, and propose pragmatic ways to remove them Explore emerging tools and techniques, and bring what works back to the team Take part in interviewing and training new team members To be successful, we think you need: Experience Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building and running production systems A track record of delivering complex work independently, from design to deployment A love of open-ended problems: you can take an early idea, shape it into a clear spec and see it through Technical Expertise & Leadership Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, and the fundamentals to pick up others quickly Solid system design skills and good judgement about trade-offs Experience with, or a real appetite for, AI-assisted and spec-driven development, with the judgement to know when to trust AI output and when to challenge it A working understanding of cloud platforms (we use Azure and AWS), CI/CD pipelines and automated testing Hands-on experience with Docker and containerisation Good instincts for debugging, observability and performance in production systems Fluency with Git and modern development workflows Working knowledge of databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) A habit of making the engineers around you better through mentoring, review and clear communication Nice to have DevOps or platform engineering experience, such as GitOps deployments with ArgoCD, infrastructure as code, and/or Kubernetes Experience with performance testing or reliability engineering What’s in it for you? Nintex has a hybrid working model, enabling us to build culture, learn, and grow together. We intentionally connect and collaborate, while emphasizing flexibility with a blend of at-home and in-office work. This role is a hybrid role in our local Nintex office. While our offerings differ from country to country, we offer our entire global workforce an array of exciting perks and benefits, including Global Gratitude and Recharge Days Flexible, paid time off policy Employee wellness programs and counseling resources Meaningful peer recognition and awards Paid parental leave Invention/patenting assistance Community impact, paid volunteer time, and opportunities Intercultural learning and celebration Multiple tools through which to learn and grow, and an incredible global community View more about our benefits here: https://www.nintex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Global-Perks-and-Benefits.pdf. We are a 2023 Circle Back Initiative Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the
items.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: We are seeking an Order Management Specialist to join our growing Order Management function. This candidate will play a pivotal role in reviewing customer contracts, facilitating timely and accurate processing of orders, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures. Additionally, this candidate will have the opportunity to participate in key initiatives to improve order and data accuracy. The Order Management department is part of Samsara’s Finance organization. We are a highly collaborative, global team from a diverse range of backgrounds, focused on making Samsara a great place to work and develop our careers. You will work with Sales, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Business Technology, and Order-to-Cash to deliver a seamless order experience for our customers. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, possesses a strong attention to detail and appreciation for process, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys collaborating with other teams to solve challenges. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Review customer orders prior to shipping, ensuring the products, pricing, and terms are accurate, complete, and compliant with company policy. Reconcile customer order information against the internal system of record. Coordinate with Sales, Sales Ops, and Deal Desk to determine the resolution path for any order discrepancies. Respond to Sales inquiries regarding opportunity status or any questions on the opportunity closure process. Collaborate with your global peers to identify solutions for common order issues and drive global consistency in process. With the support of management, identify and support implementation of improvements to Samsara’s systems and tools to streamline the order review process. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, such as Sales Ops, Order to Cash, and Business Technology, on company projects. Support the generation and ongoing maintenance of reporting dashboards to track order volume and activity. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: 2+ years of professional work experience. Professional-level written and verbal fluency in English. Excellent attention to detail with an emphasis on accuracy and timeliness. Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a larger team. Ability to multitask, adapt, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. A continuous improvement mindset and openness to feedback. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously. Ability to work during Pacific time zone business hours. Ability to work extended hours during month and quarter end. An ideal candidate also has: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. Proficiency with CRM and CPQ platform (Salesforce preferred). Experience in a contract specialist, order management, and/or related Finance role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company. Appreciation for leveraging data to instigate meaningful business process change. Aptitude for building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders and peers. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. items.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
items.summary: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.description: CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world. Visit our website at www.cleanspark.com. Job Overview The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities. Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments. Key Responsibilities Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders Preferred Qualifications Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability $200,000 - $250,000 a year This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark’s vehicle insurance policy. CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Position Summary We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to be the first dedicated seller for the Virtuous Donor Experience product: Raise. This position is structured similarly to a Founding Account Executive role, so you won’t just inherit a playbook, you’ll write it: shaping the sales process and influencing the GTM approach for Raise while owning your own book of business from first outreach to close. If hired, you will join a leading company in the nonprofit software space, recognized by Inc 5000 and as an Inc Best Workplace. Raise is our online giving platform. It gives nonprofits full control over how their giving pages look and feel, connects to their CRM, and helps them manage the donor relationship from the first gift onward. As our first dedicated Raise seller, you get to build the process from the ground up. You’ll report to sales leadership and work day to day with the Raise GM, Marketing, our BDR team, and the Virtuous Partner network. You’ll help decide how Raise is sold (segments, qualification, stages, messaging) and then go sell it. You’ll own your own book of business and run the full sales cycle, from the first outreach through discovery, demos, proposals, and close. This role is remote-friendly. Responsibilities Build pipeline. Pick target segments, build account lists, and run outbound while also developing referrals, partners, and warm leads Sell to the people who own online giving at a nonprofit (digital, marketing, development, and executive leaders) and guide multi-stakeholder buying decisions Run full sales cycles: discovery, online demos, pricing, proposals, negotiation, and close Work with partners (agencies, consultants, and technology providers) on shared pursuits, and use those relationships to open doors and move deals forward Work with sales leadership and the Raise GM to shape the Raise sales process, including qualification criteria, discovery frameworks, and messaging Partner with our BDR team and Marketing on outbound sequences, campaigns, and events Work with our CRM sellers on accounts where Raise and Virtuous CRM overlap Learn the nonprofit fundraising space quickly and become an expert on online giving, donor conversion, and payments Bring what you hear in the market back to the Raise team so it shapes the product and the pitch Participate in AFP (Association of Fundraising Professionals) events, fundraising activities, and networking opportunities You Must Have 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience as a consistent top performer Experience in an early-stage sales team or a new product line, where you helped build the process, the playbook, or the team itself A track record of building pipeline, including your own outbound Comfort with ambiguity. You don’t need a finished playbook, and you’d rather write it than wait for it Experience selling to nonprofits, or selling fundraising, giving, or payments technology Skill at explaining complex topics simply, and the ability to run your own software demos Experience working with CRMs, sales engagement tools, and other cloud software Strong time and task management. You know where to spend your time and you protect it A competitive streak and a bias toward action A passion for helping nonprofits and a desire to understand what makes one tick A willingness to experiment, change, and grow The ability to take your work seriously without taking yourself too seriously Nice to Have Existing relationships in the nonprofit world, especially with agencies, consultants, or technology partners that serve nonprofits Experience selling online giving, donation forms, peer-to-peer, or payments products Experience selling into larger organizations with longer cycles and custom integration needs Experience in the nonprofit sector yourself About Us Virtuous software is powering the world’s leading nonprofits and inspiring a new generation of generosity. At Virtuous, we believe generosity has the power to transform the world - and so we are on a mission to create $10B in net new generosity by helping nonprofits better connect with and inspire their donors. Our talented team is hungry, humble, and committed to delivering best-in-class software solutions, customer success interactions, and sales experiences to the nonprofit community. Our values are more than just a poster on the wall. Instead, our mission and values are precisely why candidates choose Virtuous. Our core values are: Build Better : We build audacious ideas to accelerate philanthropy and dismantle the status quo. Display Radical Generosity : We are generous with our time & talent as we serve our team and the nonprofit community. Stay Humble & Enjoy the Journey : We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Virtuous should act as a career accelerator for everyone on our team. Team members should look back at their time at Virtuous as one of the most productive and stretching seasons in their professional lives. This means that working at Virtuous isn’t for everybody. It is for the select few who are ready to do hard things and build something truly great. If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to apply! What We Offer Market competitive pay leveraging Carta data Employee recognition through Bonusly (birthdays, anniversaries, achievements, etc.) 401(k) retirement plan with company matching- 50% match up to 6% of compensation after 90 days We value our employee’s work-life balance and encourage taking advantage of Unlimited PTO Supportive time off including paid volunteer days and company holidays Employer-contributed healthcare benefits, encompassing medical, dental, and vision coverage, with plans available for dependents and choices for Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA). 12 weeks primary parent leave, 4 weeks secondary parent leave - full pay (adoption as well) We pride ourselves on Community and host exciting company outings and events. We’ve recently noticed an increase in recruitment scams where individuals are impersonating recruiters to obtain personal or financial information through fraudulent interviews and job offers. Please note that all legitimate communication from Virtuous will only come from the @virtuous.org domain. If you receive a message from other domains, even if they look similar (e.g., virtuouscareers.org or virtuousjobs.com), they are not legitimate and we recommend disregarding it immediately.

items.description: About Avalere Health United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources. Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves. We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you’d like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application. About the role Avalere Health is looking for a curious and collaborative Consultant II, US RWE to join our Evidence & Strategy practice. In this role, you’ll help shape data-driven healthcare strategies, deliver impactful insights, and bring those insights to life through compelling, client-ready storytelling. You’ll also play a key role in enhancing Avalere’s offerings through your specialised US healthcare knowledge, applying your subject matter expertise and broader understanding of the healthcare landscape to collaborate across teams and connect work across the practice. Over time, you’ll develop as a trusted resource for both colleagues and clients, contributing to high-quality, insight-driven work. About the Evidence & Strategy Practice Avalere Health is a vibrant community of innovative thinkers dedicated to solving the challenges of the healthcare industry. We dig deep into the healthcare system and work closely with clients to develop practical solutions. At Avalere Health, we prize curiosity, resilience, a positive attitude, and an enthusiasm to embrace new challenges. Join us and get ready to make your mark on healthcare! Avalere’s Evidence & Strategy practice provides exceptional consultation, evidence, and insights on key aspects of healthcare – including patient-centric HEOR, US real world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging claims, EHR, and other data sources, data optimization, quality, shared decision-making, value-based care, and health equity – and to shape strategy for our clients. Our mission is to improve quality of care, craft data-driven strategies, drive patient-centric outcomes, and ultimately provide the highest value to all our partners, including life sciences companies, payers, providers, and patient advocates. Our work is focused in 3 intersecting strategic pillars: Patient-Centric Value, Evidence & Analytics, and Healthcare Strategy. What you’ll do Apply statistical, epidemiological, and/or econometric expertise to research and client deliverables. Collaborate with programmers, statisticians, and other researchers to analyze large US healthcare datasets (e.g., patient or claims data) to uncover insights and inform strategy. Create compelling, client-ready presentations and reports that tell a clear and engaging story. Contribute to scientific publications, conference materials, and thought leadership. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes for clients. Take ownership of multiple project workstreams, managing budgets, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication with minimal oversight. Lead and contribute to client meetings, presenting deliverables and shaping next steps. Support day-to-day client engagement, helping to manage expectations and deliver high-quality outcomes. Support business development through proposals, contributing to scopes of work, and identifying opportunities for growth within client accounts. Provide guidance and mentorship to support the development of junior team members. Develop subject matter expertise and contribute as a trusted resource internally and externally. Stay up to date with US healthcare trends to bring fresh, relevant perspectives to your work. About you Advanced degree (MA/MS or PhD) in a relevant field such as epidemiology, health economics, public health, statistics, or similar Minimum 5 years of professional experience, preferably in life sciences consulting. Relevant healthcare or pharmaceutical/device industry work will also be considered. Strong analytical skills with experience working with US healthcare data (claims or EHR data highly valued) Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines A collaborative mindset and confidence working in cross-functional teams A proactive, curious approach with a passion for improving healthcare outcomes Experience presenting research results at scientific conferences and/or a record of peer-review publications $110,000 - $132,000 a year What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health. We may use AI tools to support elements of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing CV/resumes, assessing responses, or transcribing interviews. These tools assist our Talent team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please review our candidate privacy policy.

items.description: About Figure Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933. Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies. About the Role We’re looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to join our growing team! As Sales Operations Analyst, you’ll support all aspects of the day-to-day Sales function. The role is a mix of direct sales rep support, data integrity, tactical task execution, and task automation. You’ll be highly detail oriented and comfortable getting in the weeds, while always looking for ways to create efficiencies. You’ll join a team of stellar Sales and Marketing Operations analysts and work closely with Sales Representatives, Sales Leaders, Marketing, and cross-functional teams. What You’ll Do Serve as the primary point of contact for Salesforce and Ops Console user support, addressing and resolving questions from the sales team Own daily, weekly, and monthly “Run the Business” operations, such as lead and account assignment, data integrity updates, email triaging, and report building Identify areas for improvement, optimize current tasks, and automate manual processes to enhance efficiency and reduce manual work Act as the first line of defense for production support bugs and feature feedback, filing Jira tickets on behalf of the sales team and escalating as needed Maintain comprehensive documentation for all sales processes and Run the Business tasks Learn the “build” side of Sales Ops, assisting with field creation, Flows, page layouts, and list views when possible Assist in new sales tool setup, training, rollout, onboarding, and adoption monitoring Create and maintain standardized reports and dashboards to monitor pipeline health, data integrity, and key performance indicators in Salesforce Support the hygiene and administration of Salesforce through routine data clean-ups and report notifications Execute quarterly projects aimed at elevating sales team efficiency and efficacy Assist in building out Salesforce tools for the New Construction team What We Look For Bachelor’s degree 1+ years of experience in a Sales Operations capacity Experience using Salesforce Highly detail oriented Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to manage time effectively across multiple work streams and juggle multiple projects Strong analytical skills and the ability to thrive in a data-rich environment Experience collaborating effectively with business stakeholders, sales reps, and cross-functional teams Ability to create thorough documentation of work Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Job title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist – AI Trainer Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach
