Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? items.title: 3D Spatial Data Expert (AI Community)
items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.summary: Description If you are ready to take a next step in your accounting career, and you feel that energy industry is where you can find the thrill (we definitely do!), keep reading - and if that’s a match, we’ll be happy to set you up with our HR crew for an interview. Location: Spain or Belgium, but remote set up is also possible within European E&C G
items.description: Description If you are ready to take a next step in your accounting career, and you feel that energy industry is where you can find the thrill (we definitely do!), keep reading - and if that’s a match, we’ll be happy to set you up with our HR crew for an interview. Location: Spain or Belgium, but remote set up is also possible within European E&C Group Locations Team: Global Finance Team 💡Why E&C Consultants? We’re proud to be a Great Place To Work® certified company, where satisfaction, growth, and flexibility are our way of working. You can read more details here: Becoming an E&Cer, but here’s what makes us stand out: We put people first: employee fulfilment, pride and well-being are balanced and at the heart of everything we do We grow together: as E&C expands, so do your opportunities to develop professionally We work differently: our Teal management means no micromanagement - just empowerment and flat structure We give you time to recharge: enjoy 46 days off per year, no matter where you live or work About the role: We are looking for a detail-oriented Group Accountant to join our Group Finance Team and support the accurate and timely financial reporting of E&C’s entities. You’ll own key month‑end activities: from posting close entries to balance‑sheet and intercompany reconciliations. Help review the monthly numbers to spot anything that doesn’t add up. You’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and external accounting/tax partners to make sure reporting is accurate, complete and on time. It’s a hands‑on role for someone who knows double‑entry and accrual accounting, enjoys digging into financial data like a number detective, and takes pride in owning and resolving discrepancies. You’ll start by owning a few specific entities and accounting areas and getting to know the numbers inside out. We’re looking for someone curious and analytical who can read what a balance or transaction really means, flag anything that looks off, and chase it down until it’s fixed. As you settle in, there’s plenty of room to grow: take on more entities, tackle trickier accounting issues, and broaden your role in group financial reporting. Requirements 🎯 Do you already feel like E&C is a place for you? Let’s see if this particular role is also what you’re good at. As a Group Accountant you will be trusted with: Month-end close: Own the month‑end close for your assigned entities: prepare journal entries and adjustments, review the monthly numbers, spot anything that doesn’t add up, investigate discrepancies and drive them to a clean resolution so reporting is accurate and on time Month-end review: Support the review of monthly financial results for assigned entities and accounting areas, identifying unusual balances, discrepancies or potential accounting errors and investigating items requiring explanation or correction Reconciliations: Prepare monthly balance‑sheet reconciliations (accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, etc.) and run intercompany reconciliations: find mismatches, investigate the causes and work with colleagues to clear items and post any corrective entries Internal and external collaboration: Partner closely with the Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and our external accounting and tax partners to coordinate month‑end tasks and make sure the close and reporting are timely and accurate Information provision: Prepare clear reconciliations, schedules and supporting explanations so the Group Finance Team and external partners have everything they need for reporting and tax work Issue resolution: Investigate accounting discrepancies and outstanding items and work collaboratively with the wider Group Finance Team and external partners to ensure they are appropriately resolved Group-wide consistency: Help ensure that accounting treatments, close procedures and supporting documentation are applied consistently across E&C’s entities Continuous improvement: Help make finance smarter and more efficient. Suggest and implement better processes, controls and close procedures, and spot ways to use systems and tech to save time and reduce errors 🧩 We feel that to be successful & satisfied in this role, it’s good to bring a mix of curiosity, analytical thinking, and a grounded accounting mindset. Ideally, we look for: A good understanding of double-entry accounting and core accounting principles. You understand debits, credits and why they matter Clear understanding of the accruals concept , you recognise income and expenses in the right period so the numbers tell the true story Strong numerical skills and a keen eye for detail A special talent for spotting when balances or postings look wrong, and the persistence to dig in and find the root cause Good organisational skills and the ability to work effectively to deadlines Spreadsheet savvy, you use Excel/Sheets to analyse, reconcile and present tidy supporting workpapers Comfortable collaborating with internal colleagues and external accounting/tax professionals Proactive, adaptable and curious. You enjoy learning new systems and looking for smarter ways to work A strong working level of English , both written and spoken 🌟 These desirable skills will help you shine in the role (but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box): Relevant accounting experience, including practical involvement in month-end close activities, is highly desirable. Previous experience working in a multi-entity environment would also be beneficial. Experience using the following accounting or ERP packages would be beneficial although not required: Exact Online, QuickBooks Online, Xero, DATEV, Sage and enova365. You don’t need a professional accounting qualification to apply. We value hands‑on accounting experience and solid technical knowledge above formal certification! If you are still here and reading, you must be really interested. Great, as E&C is the best place to be! Last but not least then, a sneak peek into our application process: First call with HR or Team Leader - 45min Assessment: online ability tests + personality questionnaire - 45min Final round interview: Business case (can be prepared in advance) & discussion on the online assessment + meeting the team - 90min Send your application by clicking on the application button. Please send us your CV in English only and include the following statement in your application: “I hereby give consent for my personal data included in my application to be processed for the purposes of the recruitment process under the Personal Data Protection Act as of 29 August 1997, consolidated text: Journal of Laws 2015, item 2135 as amended”

items.title: Legal Counsel & Procurement Manager at SpotMe
items.summary: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product t
items.description: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel. This position is the ideal role for a legal professional who wants to make a direct impact on business operations. You’ll establish and own critical processes that directly affect our bottom line and business efficiency. You’ll develop your legal and commercial skills while building systems that scale with our company. As a Legal Counsel & Procurement Manager, you will be reporting to the CFO and you will split your time between: Commercial legal support (40%): Reviewing MSAs and SOWs for the deal desk, redlining third-party contracts, standardizing our commercial terms, ensuring legal compliance in sales documents, and supporting the closing process in timely manner Procurement and vendor management (20%): Support the business with new vendor and vendor evaluations, leading contract negotiations, managing renewal timelines, and optimizing pricing Non-commercial legal (20%): Managing employment agreements, contractor agreements, NDAs, and other internal legal documents Scaling legal and procurement systems (20%): Maintaining our contract management system, building a legal request ticketing system, automating repetitive work with AI, creating standardized workflows and developing procurement policies You will work with the Paralegal, who reports to you, and serve as the key point of contact for compliance matters with both internal teams and external stakeholders. “Bring order to contracts, save money on vendors, and close deals faster” will be your motto. Objectives - The problems you will solve In your first month, you will: Review our current commercial T&Cs and identify areas for standardization and simplification Shadow the deal desk to understand their workflow and pain points related to MSAs and SOWs Get up to speed on our contract management system and review all renewals due in the next 6 months, identifying immediate cost-saving opportunities After 3 months, you will: Launch a legal request intake (ticketing) system: one front door for all legal and procurement requests, with triage, assignment to the right owner and status tracking Create standardized templates for common commercial agreements and negotiation silver bullets (for most frequently negotiated items) that reduce redlining time Formalize our vendor evaluation and selection process, building on current practices After 12 months, you will: Reduce our procurement (software, services) costs by at least 10% through strategic negotiation and vendor consolidation, with specific targets of 5% on renewals and 20% on new acquisitions Process 80% of commercial agreements within the same business day of receipt Have trained and coached the Paralegal so she handles standard commercial requests autonomously Run our contract repository proactively: 100% of renewals flagged at least 90 days ahead and renegotiated before notice deadlines Handle at least 50% of standard requests (NDAs, standard DPAs, routine vendor reviews) through self-service or AI-assisted workflows What you need to be great at: Commercial contract expertise: you negotiate MSAs, SOWs and DPAs pragmatically, knowing which points to hold and which to concede. Negotiation and vendor management: you get better prices and terms from vendors, and have the numbers to prove it. Speed with judgement: you balance thoroughness with sales velocity and help deals close faster, not slower. Structure and ownership: you build processes and systems, such as templates, playbooks and request tracking, and own them end to end. Automation and AI-first mindset: you look at every manual task and ask whether it needs to be manual. You use workflows, templates and AI assistants such as Claude every day (first-pass contract review against our playbook, drafting redlines, comparing clauses, summarizing vendor terms, answering routine legal questions), and you turn them into repeatable tools the business can use on its own, such as self-service NDAs or a contract Q&A assistant, while keeping human judgement where it matters. What we are most curious about: Tell us about a time you sped up contract turnaround in a sales-driven company. What changed, and what were the numbers? What’s the biggest saving you’ve negotiated with a vendor, and how did you get there? Which legal or procurement task have you automated or handed to AI, and what did it free up? How do you decide what to handle yourself, what to delegate to a paralegal, and what to send to external counsel? SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the fut
items.description: Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world’s most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We’re in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We’re solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We’re looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. About This Role: The Field Service Technician – Mechanical Integration & Field Site Acceptance plays a vital role in the field deployment, mechanical integration, site acceptance testing (SAT), and field support for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) data center infrastructure. Operating directly within client and enterprise data center sites, the technician ensures high-reliability installation and mechanical validation of Modular Data Centers (MDCs), power distribution skids, high-density GPU/server racks, thermal containment systems, and cooling manifolds. This role focuses on field installation, precision physical alignment, site acceptance protocols, and non-licensed low-voltage support (24VDC/signal control circuits). This position operates strictly within a non-certified electrical scope; all high-voltage electrical connections and certified electrician tasks are strictly excluded. What You’ll Be Working On: Mechanical Integration & Field Installation Perform on-site mechanical positioning, structural anchor mounting, and precision alignment for modular data centers (MDCs), GPU/server rack assemblies, power skids, and containment structures. Rig, position, level, and secure heavy OEM sub-assemblies and fluid distribution manifolds using precision leveling gear, torque tools, and field rigging equipment. Execute field installation of cooling lines, quick-disconnect (QD) fittings, and fluid interconnects following engineering drawings and exact torque specifications. Conduct field structural integrity checks, vibration isolation verifications, and environmental sealing on modular enclosures. Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) & Quality Verification Execute Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) protocols for newly landed OEM equipment to verify mechanical integrity and installation readiness prior to final customer handover. Perform mechanical and visual quality inspection checklists during uncrating, landing, and positioning at client facilities. Document SAT outcomes, maintain field test logs, and compile detailed punch-lists for any mechanical or cosmetic anomalies observed on site. Partner with client data center facility teams, general contractors, and commissioning engineers to resolve field integration issues efficiently. Non-Licensed Low-Voltage Control & Signal Support Support low-voltage control circuits (24VDC, sensor loops, and signal lines) on OEM equipment as non-licensed field support. Perform basic multi-meter continuity checks and voltage measurements on non-energized control loops and terminal blocks. Execute precise wire stripping, terminal block termination, crimping, wire lacing, and cable management inside OEM control cabinets. Observe strict electrical boundary limits: high-voltage AC connections, main electrical panel wiring, and licensed electrician duties are explicitly out of scope. Field Service & Technical Documentation Serve as the primary technical field representative for OEM equipment landing, mechanical troubleshooting, and field modification kits. Complete daily site logs, field service reports, redline drawing revisions, and material tracking forms accurately. Adhere strictly to environment, health, and safety (EHS) guidelines, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) rules, and site-specific Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures. What You’ll Bring to the Team: High school diploma or equivalent; trade school diploma or technical certification in mechanical technology, field service, or industrial maintenance is highly desirable. 2–5+ years of practical field service, mechanical installation, or field integration experience within data centers, critical facilities, industrial power, or HVAC environments. Hands-on proficiency with mechanical hand/power tools, torque wrenches, precision measurement devices, and leveling equipment. Ability to read and interpret mechanical assembly drawings, structural layouts, and field installation procedures. Physical capacity to lift up to 50 lbs unassisted, work in confined spaces inside modular units, and perform work at elevated heights safely. Mobility and willingness to travel to client data center project locations as required. Bonus Points: OEM Data Center Equipment: Direct field experience with modular data centers (MDCs), power skids, server/GPU rack containment, and fluid distribution manifolds. Basic Electrical Wiring & Schematics: Familiarity with low-voltage wiring fundamentals, reading control schematics, wire stripping, terminal block wiring, and cable lacing techniques. Low-Voltage Diagnostics: Hands-on experience operating digital multimeters for non-energized continuity verification and low-voltage (24VDC/signal) troubleshooting. Hydraulic & Cooling Systems: Working knowledge of liquid cooling loops, pressure testing procedures, and quick-disconnect manifold connections. Safety Credentials: Active OSHA 10 / OSHA 30 card, NFPA 70E awareness, and signalperson/rigging safety training. Benefits: Competitive compensation and equity packages Restricted Stock Units Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance Employer contributions to HSA account Paid parental leave Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability Professional development & tuition reimbursement Mental health & wellness support Commuter benefits (parking & transit) Cell phone stipend 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary Volunteer time off Global travel insurance & emergency assistance Daily meals allowance Additional perks & programs specific to location Compensation Range Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $46.25/HR + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDMFG) Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The OpportunityAs a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Agile Program Manager
items.summary: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable. What You Bring 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments. Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release. Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar). Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting. Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation. Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike. Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones. Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves. Nice to Have Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile. Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization. Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery. Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management. Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements. Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners. Please mention the word **PHENOMENALLY** and tag RNTIuMTczLjIxOS4xNDg= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjIxOS4xNDg=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. items.title: AI Developer
items.summary: Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it. Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role. You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work. Key Responsibilities AI / LLM Engineering (core focus) Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments. Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality. Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources. Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features. items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

We help companies reduce risk, prevent disruptions, and build more resilient and adaptive enterprises. The Opportunity We are seeking a highly experienced, proactive Senior Executive Assistant to serve as a trusted partner to our executive leadership team. This person will anticipate needs, manage competing priorities with minimal direction, and keep our executives organized, efficient, and focused on what matters most. The ideal candidate has supported C-level leaders in a fast-moving environment, communicates with clarity and sound judgment, and brings a strategic, solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction. Essential Functions/Duties Provide high-level, proactive administrative and strategic support to the CEO and members of the executive leadership team, anticipating needs and resolving issues befo re they escalate. Manage complex, high-volume calendars, prioritizing and scheduling internal and external meetings across time zones from HST to EST, and making sound judgment calls on competing demands. Coordinate travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries. items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Switzerland URL: https://meticsmedia.com Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results. AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works. We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow. What You'll Do You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work. Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers. Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication. Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high. Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products. Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out. Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve. You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life. What We're Looking For You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand. You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work. You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth. You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively. You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content. You're creative, proactive, and independent . You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results. You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products . Why Join Us? We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team. You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business. We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results. What We Offer 100% remote work with an international team. Paid time off and national holidays to recharge. Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being. Computer budget for a comfortable workspace. Kindle and access to our company Amazon account. Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world. Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact. Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: URL: https://careers.mozaiq.com About LiftPilot LiftPilot is an AI-powered website personalization platform for B2B companies. We help marketing and growth teams give every visitor a tailored website experience, turning more traffic into engagement, qualified pipeline and conversions. The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the market. We’re live with our first pilots and the results so far have been exceptional. The role LiftPilot is early enough that how we sell is still an open question, and you’d be the person answering it — figuring out who bites, what lands, which deals are worth chasing and which aren’t. You won’t be doing that from a standing start: the founding team is deep in this market, so the product knowledge, the context and the second opinions are all a message away. You’d run the whole cycle yourself, target list through to signed. The pipeline you work is the pipeline you build, and what you learn building it is what LiftPilot’s sales motion becomes. If you want a process to follow, this isn’t it. If you want to be the reason there’s a process at all, let’s talk. What you'll do Build your own target list and book every meeting through your own outreach: email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Sell to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen and growth leaders at B2B companies. Run discovery calls, and prepare a tailored demo for each first meeting. Help your champion make the case internally, and position LiftPilot against existing tools, agencies and internal builds. Negotiate and close new business, and set each new customer up for a smooth start. Keep an accurate, honest pipeline in the CRM. Bring what you hear from buyers back into the product. What you need 4+ years as a quota-carrying Account Executive closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a record of hitting your number. Selling to marketing leaders. You've sold to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen or growth leaders, not IT or finance. MarTech sales experience. You’ve sold marketing technology, such as website personalization, ABM, CRO, advertising, analytics or content tools. Early-stage experience. You've carried a number at an early-stage company, ideally as one of its first two salespeople. Self-sourced pipeline. Most of your pipeline came from your own outreach, and you can walk us through how you built it. Selling without proof. You've closed deals with no case studies or references to point to. Strong writing. You write cold emails that get replies. Organized and self-directed. You plan your week, follow up without being chased, and write down what's working. Curiosity about the product. You want to understand how it works, not just pitch it. You Close. You push deals to a decision rather than letting them drift. You’re comfortable asking for the signature, chasing the fourth follow-up, and naming the thing that’s blocking a deal instead of waiting it out. Nice to have Experience selling website personalization, ABM, CRO or experimentation platforms. Experience selling AI products. Experience in a founder-led sales team. Experience navigating buying committees in mid-market and enterprise deals. This role isn't for you if You need an SDR, a territory or an account list to hit your number. Most of your past pipeline came from inbound or leads you were handed. You're looking for a VP or Head of Sales title right away. What we offer Base salary: $100,000 to $125,000 USD, depending on experience. Uncapped commission on every deal you close. Fully remote. Direct access to the founder, product team, and to have real influence on how we sell. Room to grow as the sales team grows. Our hiring process 1. Intro call 2. Conversation with our founder 3. Pitch us. Run us through a pitch for your current company’s product, the way you’d do it on a real first call. 4. Paid take-home exercise We give you a list of companies; you show us how you'd prioritize them and draft your first outreach. 5. Team session. Walk us through your exercise, then work through a few real buyer scenarios with the team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mozaiq-founding-account-executive

items.title: Policy Lead, AI Infrastructure at Stripe
items.summary: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
