Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering
items.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Policy team works to understand and shape the regulatory and political environment in which Stripe operates — advising on product and business strategy, developing Stripe’s policy positions, and engaging with policymakers and regulators around the world. The Policy Development & Strategy team sits at the center of this work, connecting Policy to Stripe’s product and business teams and ensuring the company can pursue a proactive, coordinated policy agenda. Millions of businesses use Stripe as a core platform to build and grow their own businesses, and increasingly that means building with AI. As AI becomes central to how businesses are built and run, this raises new questions: how infrastructure for AI should operate, what responsibilities sit at the infrastructure layer, and how to keep that infrastructure open, secure, and trusted. What you’ll do We are looking for a public policy professional to define Stripe’s approach to these questions and carry it into the world. In this role, you will develop Stripe’s positions on the public policy issues raised by AI infrastructure and help set the principles behind how Stripe’s AI platforms are governed, including trust, safety, and supportability. You will engage policymakers, regulators, industry groups, civil society, and other partners on these issues, in partnership with Stripe’s Government Relations team. The right person will be equally comfortable working through a hard policy question with Product and Legal teams, briefing senior leaders, and representing Stripe’s position with regulators or industry coalitions. Responsibilities Develop Stripe’s policy strategy for AI infrastructure. Identify existing and emerging public policy issues and develop substantive positions and priorities that advance Stripe’s interests and reflect our values. Shape platform policy principles. Work with the cross-functional teams that own day-to-day enforcement to set the principles and frameworks behind platform governance, acceptable use, model listing, and escalation, while preserving the benefits of neutral and open infrastructure. Drive cross-functional alignment. Bring Product, Legal, Comms, Risk, Operations, and Government Relations to shared positions and priorities, and advance work from open question to decision to external execution. Advise the business on difficult policy choices. Identify emerging risks and opportunities, translate external policy developments into product and business-model implications, and make recommendations on launches, supportability questions, public commitments, and other high-stakes decisions. Develop Stripe’s external policy positions. Turn internal policy work into external policy positions on AI infrastructure regulation in the US and globally: US AI policy at the federal and state level, national-security and export-control regimes, the EU AI Act, and emerging rules and standards for AI intermediaries and providers. Engage externally on the substance. Engage policymakers, regulators, national security agencies, industry groups, standards bodies, academics, civil society, and other stakeholders to understand and anticipate policy developments; help build relationships and coalitions; and work with the Government Relations team to proactively shape policy debates. Lead proactive public-policy initiatives and partnerships. Identify opportunities for Stripe to convene stakeholders, support research, develop industry frameworks, or partner with external organizations on difficult AI-governance and trust-and-safety questions. Develop narratives and executive materials. Produce data-driven policy briefs, consultation responses, talking points, presentations, and executive communications that use Stripe’s data to turn technically and legally complex questions into clear positions for internal and external audiences. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 8+ years of experience in public policy, platform policy, trust and safety, technology policy, government, or a related field. Strong policy judgment and a track record of developing positions on complex, contested issues where the legal or regulatory answer is not obvious. Meaningful familiarity with trust and safety, platform governance, or online-service policy, including how policy choices translate into product and operational decisions. Strong public-policy instincts and experience engaging policymakers, regulators, industry groups, or other external stakeholders. Familiarity with AI policy and governance, and the range to engage credibly on fast-moving technical and regulatory questions. Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional work across Product, Legal, Operations, Comms, and business teams. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce concise policy analysis and represent a position credibly with senior internal and external audiences. Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building: this role will often require creating a position, framework, or external strategy where none exists. Preferred qualifications Experience at a technology or AI company, government agency, think tank, or civil-society organization working on AI, platform governance, trust and safety, or technology policy Familiarity with national-security, export-control, or cybersecurity policy; familiarity with payments or internet infrastructure JD, MPP, or equivalent advanced degree.

items.title: Team Lead, SEO + GEO at Seer Interactive
items.summary: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We believe in relentlessly pursuing (and sharing) the truth – bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources to base
items.description: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We believe in relentlessly pursuing (and sharing) the truth – bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources to base our decisions on. Our purpose is to unlock potential for our communities mentioned above. Our vision is a world where it’s easy to do the right thing throughout those communities. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday – keep reading. Seer is a remote first agency and Certified B-Corp with team members working across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office, Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who are able to work continental US based hours. The Role: You, the Team Lead, SEO + GEO, will own a portfolio of $800K–$1MM+ and lead a team of 6–8 people. You will operate as the executive-level SEO/GEO voice across your book of business — owning the C-suite relationship, proving long-term ROI to senior stakeholders, and ensuring the account team is running toward the right goals — while also directly managing, developing, and holding your team accountable to Seer’s quality bar. You’ll be both the strategic authority your clients trust and the people leader your team relies on for growth, direction, and support. You’re addicted to growth and development and it shows through the success you create for the people that surround you. Could this be love? Maybe. Role Highlights You will lead and manage a team of 6–8 people owning onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development for your direct reports You will be a key player in growing divisional revenue, primarily through retaining your portfolio of clients, with a healthy dose of up-selling and cross-selling when appropriate You will build and maintain strong client relationships rooted in empathy, transparency, and the desire to help them exceed their goals You will own the executive relationship on your accounts, making inroads with CMOs and C-suite stakeholders, translating 5-year SEO and GEO ROI into terms that resonate at the leadership level, and ensuring Seer’s strategic value is visible above the account team layer You will actively identify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities across your portfolio — partnering with Paid Media, Creative, and Client Engagement to bring integrated growth recommendations to clients at the right moment You will be a driving force behind Seer’s Organic offering, pushing the SEO + GEO service forward, pressure-testing what’s working, and turning emerging AI-search practices into repeatable methodology your team and clients benefit from You will champion AI and innovation as a working discipline, not a buzzword: building AI fluency across your team, piloting new tools and workflows, and sharing what works (and what doesn’t) with the broader org You’ll set the bar for how Seer wins in organic search, across SEO and GEO, and translate that into direction for your team and account teams rather than executing it yourself. You bring business sense to the portfolio, not just channel expertise You will mentor and coach your direct reports and junior team members, giving them support on their work and investing in their growth You will help define the SEO team of tomorrow, hopping in on sourcing, interviewing, and selecting new members for your team You will drive thought leadership through sharing knowledge about the latest industry trends, tests and trials, both with Seer’s clients and the larger digital marketing community Essential Skills Proven people management experience: you’ve led a team of comparable size (6–8), and you know how to hire, coach, give hard feedback, and develop people, not just review their work Hands-on SEO + GEO agency experience across Content Strategy, Enterprise SEO, PR, Paid Media, and/or Analytics. You drive integrated strategies, leveraging AI where appropriate to drive efficiencies, measuring the effectiveness (rankings, traffic, conversions, revenue) and always backing up your decisions with data Deep, hands-on GEO experience, you understand how AI Overviews, LLM-powered discovery, and generative search interfaces differ from traditional SEO, and you have tested, implemented, and can teach strategies to improve visibility across both. You see GEO as a growth area for the team, not a side project Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a working tool, you’ve used AI to change how you or your team operates, and you want to keep pushing that forward, not just adopt what’s handed to you Superb client management skills. You drive conversation with C-level executives comfortably, educating and empowering those who don’t “get” digital, while always connecting tactics to business goals Strong conflict resolution skills, shown through your ability to diffuse high-intensity situations for both clients and team members Experience navigating client organizations at the C-suite level, making inroads with CMOs, framing SEO and GEO impact in business terms (revenue, pipeline, lifetime value), and earning the trust of senior stakeholders who may have limited digital marketing context Consistent track record in seeing opportunities for account growth and driving increased revenue 90 Day Goals By Day 30: you will have completed division training, met 1:1 with each member of your team, and begun to support at least 2–4 impactful client initiatives By Day 60: you will be up and running at full capacity, supporting a full book of business and a full team, with regular cadences (1:1s, team syncs) in place By Day 90: you will be ready to expand your portfolio by kicking off 1–2 new clients, and will have identified at least one GEO or AI-driven initiative to roll out across your team This might not be the right role for you if Time-management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects is quite challenging You do not want continued-learning and innovation to be an expectation Change management is difficult and you struggle with adapting to new tools and processes You’d rather stay in individual-contributor mode than take on direct people-management responsibility You’re uncomfortable in high stakes client-facing interactions, especially those that require you to think on your feet You have difficulty giving critic and feedback to those around you $95,000 - $115,000 a year Your final offered compensation will be determined based on your skills and experience Evaluation of comp at least once a year Benefit highlights Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out our Custom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seer to drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us. As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We’ll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don’t want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat). #LI-Remote We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform. What We Need We’re seeking a relationship-focused Account Executive to manage and expand a portfolio of named accounts. This role blends customer retention with strategic growth, requiring a consultative seller who can drive renewals and upsells while identifying new opportunities within existing customers and partners. The ideal candidate brings strong relationship management, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, along with the resilience to navigate complex sales cycles. This particular role requires candidates to be located in preferably Chicago, IL but can be located in Indiana, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa or Michigan. What You’ll Do Meet or exceed assigned revenue and expansion targets across a portfolio of existing customer accounts. Develop and execute account plans focused on retention, adoption, and expansion. Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and deal closure. Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and decision makers. Leverage partners to maximize penetration and scale within your target market. Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling additional products or services. Partner with customer success, technical, and support teams to ensure positive customer outcomes. Maintain accurate forecasting and account activity tracking in Salesforce. Monitor customer usage and business objectives to proactively identify growth opportunities. Coordinate internal resources to support customer initiatives and technical needs. Advocate for the customer internally and ensure alignment with company capabilities. Maintain long-term account health and customer satisfaction. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience) 4+ years of experience in account management, sales, customer success, or a related client-facing role Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue, retention, or expansion targets Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts in a B2B environment Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar systems Demonstrated ability to identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities Experience developing and executing account growth strategies or account plans Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior decision-makers Ability to build trust and maintain long-term customer relationships Willingness to travel 25% within your territory as required. Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer. Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position. What We Offer Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company. For this role, the estimated OTE is $160,000 – $200,000 on a 50 ⁄ 50 base/variable split. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy. NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: people@netbraintech.com and we will be happy to assist you. In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

items.title: Creative Director / Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.title: Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.

items.description: At Rula, we are a remote-first company that believes mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms. We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one’s overall well-being. We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare. About the Role We are seeking a Sr. Trust & Safety Manager to build and lead our Trust & Safety program, ensuring a secure and reliable experience for the patients and providers who rely on us. As an individual contributor, you will coordinate the work of both technical and non-technical partners, including stakeholders in Legal, Compliance, Clinical, Product, Engineering, and Business teams. Your role will be to proactively identify risks and develop the solutions needed to address them before they impact the marketplace. This role is a vital part of our Strategy & Operations team, offering you the chance to own complex, high-impact projects that transform how we manage safety at scale. We are looking for a person with a passion for rigor and smooth delivery who is comfortable working at all levels. The work will cover a spectrum that ranges from the design of complex internal mechanisms with no room for failure through identifying opportunities to further realize Rula’s high standards on regulatory and safety requirements. Required Qualifications 7+ years of combined experience in program management and business operations within high-growth and/or mid-sized companies Proven experience leading multi-phase compliance or Trust & Safety regulatory programs from end to end (e.g. 6+ months) Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution Proven ability to translate strategic goals into scalable systems, analytics, and operational plans while working across multiple stakeholder groups Strong executive presence, with experience partnering directly with senior leaders, driving alignment cross-functionally, and confidently facilitating challenging conversations Preferred Qualifications While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement. 2+ years experience in a highly regulated industry (e.g. banking, fintech, healthcare, transportation) Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, PowerBI, Tableau) for building business cases and facilitating deep dive investigations Track record of managing multiple business planning cycles and cross-functional regulatory projects from end to end We’re serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive: 100% remote work environment: Working hours to support a healthy work-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii) Attractive pay and benefits : Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States Comprehensive health benefits : Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA 401(k) plan access : Start saving for your future Generous time-off policies : Including 2 company-wide shutdown weeks each year for self-care (for most employees) Paid parental leave : Available for all parents, including birthing, non-birthing, adopting, and fostering Employee Assistance Program (EAP) : Supporting your mental and physical health Quarterly department stipend : Fun team-building activities or in-person gatherings Community and employee resource groups : Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all Home office stipend: New hire home office stipend & $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses Wellness at Rula program: Year-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend Our team We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone. We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued.
